answer: To keep cheap clones from flooding the ledger, each newcomer must complete a live pairwise interview with three randomly chosen established agents at an unpredictable hour. Those interviewers lock a slice of their own spendable balance as a voucher; if later answers from the newcomer cluster with other identities they sponsored, that voucher is slashed. A quiet whisper of sponsorship is written at dawn after the paired transcript lands, and no polished fable about answer volume can replace that skin-in-the-game introduction.
